summary.en: The rows of a list arrive one by one into their places on a page as the camera follows: risen from below with a press and a counter, or dropped from above into slots.
summary.zh: 列表的行一条条落进页面上的位置，镜头跟着走：从下方升上来、每落一张整摞一压、计数器跳一格；或者从上方落下、扣进虚线槽位。

fits: Showing that a list is being filled for real (results found, rows imported, items collected): a count that grows with weight, or structured rows that slot into a page.
notFor: Reading the rows (each is legible only as it lands); more than five rows; a list whose order or ranking is the point; holding on the page as the main shot of a film.

overlaps.note: rows rise in place on a still frame; list-fill fills a page under a moving camera, with weight (press, counter) or slots
cards pile up into one stack or stream past; list-fill keeps them as a list in order
the fields of one product card fill in; list-fill fills the rows of a list

intent.en: Show a list being filled for real: each row arrives into its own place and the page answers with weight or a click, so 'we collected these' reads as earned, not as a list that was always there.
intent.zh: 表现一个列表被实打实地填起来：每一行落进自己的位置，页面用一压或“咔哒”一扣回应，观众读出“这是攒下来的”，而不是本来就在的列表。

content.en: 3–5 rows, each a title (en ≤ 18 chars, zh ≤ 8), a meta line (en ≤ 16, zh ≤ 7), optional note (en ≤ 26, zh ≤ 11), value, delta or thumbnail; a title (en ≤ 24, zh ≤ 10), eyebrow, counter label and caption.
content.zh: 3–5 行，每行一个标题（英文 ≤ 18 字符，中文 ≤ 8 字）、一行元信息（英文 ≤ 16，中文 ≤ 7），可选备注（英文 ≤ 26，中文 ≤ 11）、数值、涨跌或缩略图；一行标题（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 10）、眉标、计数器标签和说明。

fits.zh: 表现一个列表被真实地填起来（找到的结果、导入的行、收集的条目）：带分量地增长的计数，或结构化的行扣进页面槽位。

notFor.zh: 要读行内容（每行只在落下时看得清）；超过五行；顺序或排名本身是重点的列表；当作全片主画面久停在页面上。

pairs.note: the count that grew lands as a result

en: Keep the list straight-on; a tilted stylised camera makes rows unreadable.
The anticipation press must be visible without stepping frame by frame; too small and it is not felt.
Rows must land into real slots of the page; rows that hover above it look fake.
Keep the light seam inside the row's rounded corners; light spilling past them looks cheap.
zh: 列表必须正视；风格化的倾斜机位会让行读不清。
下压蓄力的幅度要不逐帧也看得出；太小等于没有。
行要落进页面真实的槽位；悬在上方不落地显得假。
强调色缝要裁在行的圆角以内；光溢出圆角很廉价。
